description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate garden decorations arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a hanging paper lantern on a wooden post glowing warm, a square patch of stone path tiles seen from above, a short stone wall fence segment, a raised stone flower bed with colorful flowers. Bottom row: a small round stone water fountain with water spray, a wooden garden swing bench on a frame, a wind chime hanging from a small wooden post, a small stone fox statue. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
